name: KGBpmnTask
title: Knowledge graph L2-BPMN: BPMN Task
description: A task or sub-process. It is what a DMN usingTask href points at, what sequence flows connect, and what a DAK-level task entry describes. Sub-processes carry isSubProcess rather than getting a class of their own -- the lifecycle BPMN has exactly one. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/bpmn-task.

element.definition: A task or sub-process. It is what a DMN usingTask href points at, what sequence flows connect, and what a DAK-level task entry describes. Sub-processes carry isSubProcess rather than getting a class of their own -- the lifecycle BPMN has exactly one. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/bpmn-task.
The identifier the source declares (an FSH instance id, a BPMN or DMN element id).
The computable name: the CamelCase identifier a Canonical() reference matches on.
The BPMN element type (userTask, serviceTask, businessRuleTask, subProcess, …).
Whether the activity is a sub-process.
The id of the sub-process that contains it, when nested.
